afternoon_evening.name: Lentil soups with low glycemic sweet potatoes
afternoon_evening.note: Added low-glycemic source for diabetes management
afternoon_evening.pregnancy_note: In pregnancy, emphasize pairing with vitamin C sources to enhance iron absorption
enhancers: Avoid tea or coffee for at least 60 minutes before and after to facilitate iron absorption
inhibitors: Calcium (dairy, fortified plant milk) to be consumed 2+ hours beforehand or after
Phytates (whole grains, beans) to be soaked, sprouted or fermented to reduce phytate levels
medication_interactions: Cephalosporins (oral), Tetracyclines (oral), Levodopa, (oral) - flag for pharmacist referral

safety_note: No emergency, urgent, or monitor rules were triggered based on the provided symptoms and life stage context.
closing_line: This is food-based support, not a diagnosis.
